text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: Sonic Retro is a collection category for fan-made Sonic the Hedgehog games and projects created by the community. These games recreate the gameplay style of the classic Sega Genesis titles while introducing new characters, levels, mechanics, and ideas. The collection includes independent projects developed with custom engines and fan tools, preserving the fast platforming style of the original Sonic games while expanding the series through community-created content.
